hints.title: Direction of Operations
hints.text: Consider moving x down and num up at every step.

hints.title: Net Distance Change
hints.text: Each operation can decrease x by 1 and increase num by 1, closing the gap by 2.

hints.title: Formula
hints.text: The maximum achievable value occurs when x decreases by t and num increases by t, yielding x - t = num + t, so x = num + 2 * t.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct arithmetic computation of the maximum reachable value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A linear search over possible candidate values would be inefficient when a direct closed-form formula exists.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) time and O(1) space with arithmetic evaluation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that both quantities can move toward each other simultaneously by 1 each turn.
